notes: @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ place mill at berries and gather wood
Imperial Official supervising prebuild mill, rally tc to deer
@building_military/stable.webp@ and 4 new @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ for taking @resource/deer.webp@ (supervise @building_military/stable.webp@ for faster production)
@technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ and take own deer packs first

@building_military/barracks.webp@ for @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ (add @building_military/archery-range.webp@ & @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@@technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ for @unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.webp@ if opponent makes units)
When @resource/deer.webp@ come in, switch @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ food sources from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/deer.webp@
Get Regional Inspection Tech from @landmark_zhuxi/mount-lu-academy-1.webp@ and spam @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@ with a supervised @building_military/stable.webp@
1 @resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ @abilities/repair.webp@ @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@ (Make sure space is free around it for military buildings)
Build @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ from @building_economy/town-center.webp@ (may need to force drop @resource/resource_gold.webp@) and supervise @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@

5 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ gather @resource/resource_wood.png@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ & build @building_economy/mill.png@ with supervision from @unit_chinese/imperial-official.png@

description:
Build order Con Zhu'Xi donde activamos la dinastía song lo más rápido posible y metemos presión con Zhuge Nus mientras transicionamos a granjas rápido.

Los números son siempre (o casi) número de aldeanos.
Los tres guiones — significan “Cuando”.
Los tres signos de igual === significan “Después”

description:
Fast Castle Build focusing on gold gathering from relics and sacred sites

- Build 1st landmark near resources with priority on food and stone (if planning 2nd TC for late game)
- TC is always going to food once you have gold villagers
name: Zhu Xi Legacy Fast Castle [Aussie Drongo] - copy
author: aaa

notes: 2 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ from @resource/resource_food.png@ build @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.png@ near resources (@resource/rally.png@ them to @resource/resource_gold.png@)
-- If enemy @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@, move some @resource/resource_food.png@@unit_worker/villager-china.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ to make @unit_infantry/spearman-1.png@
Focus on getting to Song with @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@@resource/resource_gold.png@ drop off
Build @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@ with 9-10 @resource/resource_food.png@@unit_worker/villager-china.png@ to get to Song Dynasty
-- Queue another @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ to gather gold automatically
Build @building_military/barracks.webp@,@building_military/archery-range.png@ or @building_military/stable.png@ to counter enemy army
Focus on gathering @resource/relics.webp@  and capture @resource/sacred_sites.png@ for more @resource/resource_gold.png@
-- Balance resources to go 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ with @resource/resource_stone.png@ from @landmark_zhuxi/meditation-gardens-1.png@
-- Continue building @building_military/barracks.webp@,@building_military/archery-range.png@ or @building_military/stable.png@ to counter enemy
Go for 3rd @building_economy/town-center.webp@ if you'd like or go to @age/age_4.png@
Once all 3 are out each supervise one of the resource buildings
Build second @building_economy/town-center.webp@away from first near resources
Build other landmarks prepare for war!!!…KIV third Tc

Gather 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ , then @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_economy/mill.webp@ under @building_economy/town-center.webp@ to eat @resource/sheep.webp@ | @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ supervise @building_economy/mill.webp@  .

First @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@, then send next @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to build @building_chinese/village.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ next to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Rally 1 more @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@, then @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ for age up.

Keep 4 @resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ and send the others to @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ | @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@supervise@building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@.

Once 150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@, build @building_military/stable.webp@ near @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@. @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ supervise @resource/resource_food.webp@. Train@unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ to supervise @building_military/stable.webp@ .
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ near @landmark_zhuxi/jiangnan-tower-2.webp@. If against knight civ build @building_military/barracks.webp@ instead.

Start training @unit_chinese/zhuge-nu-2.webp@ and @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ constantly out of mill buildings. Have @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ take the 2 nearby @resource/deer.webp@ packs. Use @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ to remacro if needed or to change production. Build more @building_military/archery-range.webp@ if fights are going well and it looks like you cand end in feudal, otherwise slowly go for castle and start making @unit_cavalry/lancer-3.webp@.
